security.summary: This is a normal data-only FiveM vehicle pack: model and texture assets plus vehicle metadata and a simple manifest with file/data_file declarations only. No executable behavior, downloads, callbacks, or obfuscation were found.

repairs.issue: Manifest includes only declarative entries, but any stale or missing optional paths are ignored by the importer.
repairs.action: Regenerate the manifest from the files actually present and omit any missing or duplicate entries during import.
